verification: sha256 per file (the HF `lfs.oid`), not size alone. `LAKE MISSING` catches ABSENCE; TRUNCATION is the failure mode it cannot see — a short lake opens, queries and answers with fewer bars, and the run scores a silently different cross-section.
what: the EXPECTED content of the 40-symbol lake subset, committed BEFORE any transfer so a pull is verified against a fixed reference rather than against itself
